oracle_clues: The PR's unit test compares the sample against the expected mean n*p, as described in the PR body.
Expected mean quoted as n*p = 2.4999999999999998e-06 in the PR example.
Fix replaces exp(n * log(q)) with exp(n * log1p(-p)) in random_binomial_inversion in numpy/random/src/distributions/distributions.c.
Legacy path uses a copy legacy_random_binomial_inversion in numpy/random/src/legacy/legacy-distributions.c so legacy behaviour is unchanged.

numerical_characteristics.dtype: Samples are int64 (x.max() prints np.int64) and the sample mean is float64 (x.mean() prints np.float64); the passages do not state a dtype the discrepancy depends on.
numerical_characteristics.precision: The fix computes 1 - p as log1p(-p) rather than log(1 - p) to keep precision when p is tiny; no numeric precision threshold is given.
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Very small p: n = 50000000000, p = 5e-17, sample_size = 20000000, expected mean n*p = 2.4999999999999998e-06.
numerical_characteristics.tolerance: Test passes when abs(expected_mean - sample_mean) < 6*sigma, with sigma = sqrt(n*p*(1-p)/sample_size); the test also asserts expected_mean - 6*sigma > 0.
category_specific_evidence: Before the fix, or with the legacy interface (np.random.binomial), all values of x are 0 (x.max() is 0) for n=5e10, p=5e-17, size=2e7.
With the fixed Generator.binomial, x.mean() is about 2.25e-06 against an expected mean of 2.4999999999999998e-06.
The fix replaces exp(n*log(q)) with exp(n*log1p(-p)) in random_binomial_inversion (distributions.c).
The legacy path keeps an unaltered copy of the inversion routine (legacy_random_binomial_inversion) so the legacy interface output does not change.
The regression test test_p_extremely_small in test_generator_mt19937.py checks the sample mean against the expected mean within 6 sigma.
reproduction_risks: Legacy np.random.binomial is intentionally left unchanged, so a reproduction through the legacy interface should expect the all-zero output rather than the fixed result.
The test is statistical (random sampling with size 2e7), so the 6-sigma check depends on the RNG and seed used.
